pages.text: Open it with $(k:livingrealms.open) or by using the charter. Its pages:$(li)$(l)Overview$(): population, tier, food, taxes, capital and auto-build$(li)$(l)City Map$(): your territory, plots and roads$(li)$(l)Build$() and $(l)Projects$(): plan and manage construction

$(li)$(l)Stockpile$(): the town's shared stores$(li)$(l)Research$(): the technology tree$(li)$(l)Military$(): training, kits, garrison, stances and the alarm$(li)$(l)Blacksmith$(): equipment orders$(br2)Everything you change here is checked by the server, so nothing breaks if you click too fast.
